steps.en: Add the module and create a client in your Go service
steps.zh: 在 Go 服务中加入 module 并创建 client

steps.en: Runs QR login and updates the client token and endpoint
steps.zh: 执行扫码登录并更新 client token 与 endpoint

steps.en: Start Monitor with your handler, saved cursor, and callbacks
steps.zh: 传入处理器、已存游标与回调，启动 Monitor

steps.en: Long-polls with backoff, advances the cursor, and calls your handler
steps.zh: 长轮询并退避，更新游标后调用处理器

steps.en: Persist the cursor and decide the application reply
steps.zh: 持久化 cursor，并决定应用回复

steps.en: Uses the cached context token to send the reply
steps.zh: 使用缓存的 context token 发出回复

value.en: Your service owns bot behavior without reimplementing iLink transport and media details.
value.zh: 服务自己控制 Bot 行为，不必重写 iLink transport 与 media 细节。
